metadata.name: JotInput 100-Case Flick Input Headroom Benchmark
metadata.description: Comprehensive benchmark dataset exhibiting massive quantifiable headroom for Japanese mobile flick input.

cases.context: 近日中の再開に向けて、
cases.input: さぎょうちゅうですので
cases.notes: 11 kana -> 7 chars. Naive Viterbi risks '作業厨デスので', full typing 11 keys (4.8s). 2 keys 'さぎ' allows mid-phrase completion.

cases.notes: 8 kana -> 8 chars. Full typing 8 keys (3.6s). 2 keys 'おも' allows immediate chunk completion.
